text: For 46 years, I had the privilege of serving as a preschool educator, dedicating my career to helping children build a strong foundation for lifelong learning.

Along the way, I worked closely with families and educators to create safe, inclusive, and nurturing environments where every child could succeed. I believe in educating the whole child and know that students thrive when families, teachers, and schools work together. As a lifelong advocate for holistic, multicultural, and multilingual education, I am committed to ensuring every student feels valued, respected, and empowered to reach their full potential.

Our community's diversity is one of its greatest strengths. I will continue to champion inclusive policies that honor every voice, support academic excellence, and prepare all students for a bright future.

It would be an honor to serve on the Board of Trustees and continue giving back to the children, families, and community that have meant so much to me. I am committed to listening, leading with integrity, and making decisions that put students first.

text: My name is Marcos Alvarez, I have lived here in Palmdale, CA for 30 years. As a longtime resident, district parent, and public servant, I am committed to ensuring every child has access to a high-quality education.

My priorities are reducing class sizes, supporting and retaining outstanding teachers through competitive pay, expanding science, technology, arts, and music programs, strengthening early education opportunities, and providing students with the resources and support they need to succeed. I believe every child deserves a safe, welcoming learning environment free from bullying, where academic excellence and opportunity come first.

Recent immigration enforcement actions in Southern California have caused anxiety for many students and families. Reports indicate these operations have affected school communities and increased fear among some children and parents. Regardless of immigration status or political views, every student deserves to feel safe, respected, and able to focus on learning. As a school board member, I will support policies that keep our schools focused on education, ensure families have access to accurate information and available resources, and work to maintain a positive, inclusive and safe environment where every child has the opportunity to learn and thrive.
